name: Podcast to 15 Content Assets with Notion Approval

parameters.content:
# Podcast to 15 Assets with Notion Approval

Most episodes get one promo post and then disappear. This workflow turns a single recording into 15 ready-to-review assets and routes them through Notion, so nothing goes out without a human sign-off.

## How it works
Submit the episode through the form with a transcript file (SRT, VTT or text) or the audio. Audio is transcribed with Whisper so every line keeps its timestamp. Three focused GPT calls then write 5 timestamped clips, a newsletter, SEO show notes, a LinkedIn carousel, a LinkedIn post, an X thread and 5 quote graphic briefs. Everything is laid out on one Notion page marked Needs Review, and the reviewer gets an email with the link. A second flow watches the database: Approved moves the page to Ready to Publish and tells the submitter, while Changes Requested moves it to In Revision and emails the review notes.

## Setup steps
1. Create a Notion database with Name, Status (select), Guest (text), Asset Count (number), Submitted By (email), Review Notes (text) and Approved On (date), and share it with your Notion integration.
2. Paste the database ID into the three Notion nodes and the trigger.
3. Connect OpenAI, Notion and Gmail.
4. Fill in show name, host, audience, voice and reviewer email in **Set Show Settings**.
5. Activate, open the form URL and submit a test episode.

## Episode Intake
A hosted form collects episode details plus a transcript file, pasted transcript or audio. The prep step works out which one arrived and stops early if nothing usable was uploaded.

## Transcript with Timestamps
SRT and VTT files are parsed into [mm:ss] lines. Audio goes to Whisper as verbose JSON so segments keep start times; files must be under 25 MB. Plain-text transcripts work, but clips get no timestamps.

## Settings & AI Generation
Edit show name, host, audience, voice and reviewer email in Set Show Settings. Three separate calls keep quality up: clips and quote briefs, then newsletter and SEO show notes, then carousel, LinkedIn post and X thread.

## Notion Review Page
Builds the page layout, creates the entry as Needs Review, appends content in batches of 90 blocks to stay under Notion's limit, then emails the reviewer once.

## Approval Watcher
Polls the database every minute and only passes pages whose Status is Approved or Changes Requested. Other edits are ignored.

## Publish or Revise
Approved pages move to Ready to Publish and the submitter is told. Changes Requested moves to In Revision and sends the notes. Changing status straight away stops repeat emails.

## Credentials & Security
API key for OpenAI (also used by the Whisper request), an internal integration token for Notion and OAuth2 for Gmail. Share only this one database with the integration.

parameters.formDescription: Upload a transcript (SRT, VTT or TXT) or the audio file. You'll get the content pack in Notion for review.

values.content:
You are a podcast clip producer. Using the timestamped transcript, pick exactly 5 short-form clips and exactly 5 quote graphics.

Clips: 30-90 seconds each, self-contained, strong first line, no overlapping ranges. For each give: title, start and end (use the transcript's [mm:ss] or [h:mm:ss] markers; if the transcript has no timestamps use "n/a"), hook (on-screen caption under 10 words), whyItWorks (one line), bestPlatform (Reels, Shorts, TikTok or LinkedIn).

Quote graphics: 5 quotes copied word for word from the transcript, 8-25 words, each making sense on its own. For each give: quote, speaker, timestamp, layout, colorMood, imageIdea, designerNote.

Return only JSON: {"clips": [...], "quotes": [...]}

You are the newsletter writer and SEO editor for a podcast. Use only facts from the transcript.

newsletter: subjectLines (3 options under 50 characters), previewText (under 90 characters), body (350-450 words, markdown allowed, open with a specific moment from the episode, give 3 practical takeaways, end by inviting readers to listen).

showNotes: seoTitle (under 60 characters, includes the primary keyword), metaDescription (140-155 characters), slug, summary (2 short paragraphs), chapters (6-10 items of {time, title} taken from the transcript timestamps), keyTakeaways (5), resourcesMentioned (books, tools or people named in the episode, empty array if none), keywords (6-8).

Return only JSON: {"newsletter": {...}, "showNotes": {...}}

You write social content for a podcast. Sound like a person, not a brand account. Use only ideas from the transcript.

carousel: 8-10 slides, each {headline (under 8 words), body (under 30 words)}. Slide 1 is the hook, the last slide invites people to listen.
linkedinPost: 150-250 words, short lines, a concrete opening, at most 3 hashtags at the end.
xThread: 5-7 posts, each under 270 characters, the first one is the hook.

Return only JSON: {"carousel": {"slides": [...]}, "linkedinPost": "...", "xThread": [...]}
